lung.subtitle: Experimental pneumonia screening with DenseNet121 (trained on PneumoniaMNIST) and Grad-CAM explanations.

positive.title: Possible pneumonia pattern detected
positive.subtitle: AI classification: Positive
positive.explanation: The AI detected image patterns associated with pneumonia. This is not a confirmed diagnosis.

negative.title: No pneumonia pattern flagged
negative.subtitle: AI classification: Negative
negative.explanation: The AI did not flag a pneumonia pattern in this image. This does not rule out pneumonia.

result.notice: Educational prototype, not a medical device. Always have an X-ray reviewed by a qualified clinician.
result.scoreNote: The score is the sigmoid output of the classifier, not a validated clinical probability. Images scoring {{threshold}} or higher are classified as positive.
result.a11yHeatmap: Grad-CAM heatmap over the analysed image
result.noHeatmap: The server did not return a heatmap for this image.
result.heatmapNote: Warm colours (red, yellow) mark the regions that influenced the AI's output the most. Grad-CAM shows where the model looked, not where pneumonia is, and it can highlight irrelevant areas. It is drawn on the square, centre-cropped 224×224 image the model analysed.
result.originalNote: Your image exactly as selected. It is not stored on the server.

emergency.intro: In an emergency, show this QR to a doctor. It works once, for 5 minutes, and only a verified doctor account can open it.
emergency.sharedList: Blood type · Allergies · Active conditions · Active medication. Nothing else: no name, contacts, documents or history.
emergency.expired: This QR has expired or was revoked.
emergency.singleUse: Single use · expires automatically · generating a new one cancels this one
emergency.privacyNote: The QR contains only a random code, no medical data. The code is checked by the WWHealth server, and every access is recorded in the log above.

patient.welcomeText: Let's set up a minimal medical profile: blood type, allergies, chronic conditions and current medication. It takes a minute. Every step is optional — you can skip and complete it later.
patient.bloodText: Choose only if you are sure. A doctor may rely on it in an emergency.
patient.allergiesText: Add each allergy and how severe it is. Leave empty if you have none.
patient.conditionsText: Long-term conditions a doctor should know about.
patient.medsText: Medicines you take now. Dosage is optional.

doctor.s1Text: In an emergency the patient shows a QR that works once, for 5 minutes. Use "Scan patient QR" on your dashboard.
doctor.s2Text: You see blood type, allergies, active conditions and medication — no documents, contacts or history.
doctor.s3Text: The server records each access; the patient and you can see it in the access history.

scanner.title: Lab value scanner
scanner.intro: Text is read on the WWHealth server (digital PDF or local OCR) — nothing is sent to other services. Only explicitly written values appear. Check every value before saving. This is not a diagnosis.
scanner.noValues: No explicit lab values found. You can still upload the document.
scanner.review: {{count}} values found — verify, correct or remove them:
scanner.name: Test
scanner.noOcr: This document has no digital text and OCR is not installed on the server. You can still upload it and add the values later.
scanner.ocrNothing: No text could be read from the image. Try a sharper, straight, well-lit photo.
scanner.ocrUsed: Text read with OCR — confirm every value against the document.

labs.dateInvalid: Use YYYY-MM-DD, a real date, not in the future
labs.dateHint: The date is used in the timeline and the trend charts.
labs.dateMissing: No clear date was found in the document. Add it if you know it; otherwise the upload date is used.
labs.uncertainHint_one: {{count}} uncertain value must be confirmed or removed before saving.
labs.uncertainHint_other: {{count}} uncertain values must be confirmed or removed before saving.
labs.noValuesText: There are no explicit lab values for this document.
labs.deleteConfirmText: The values extracted for this document will be deleted. The document stays.
labs.panelEmpty: Read the values from this document and confirm them.
labs.trendsEmptyHint: Upload a lab report, confirm the values and their evolution will appear here.
labs.openTrend: Opens the trend of this analysis
labs.notNumeric: These values are not numeric, so they cannot be charted.
labs.chartNote: The chart only includes numeric values in the same unit. Green band = the reference range printed in the document, when identical for every measurement.
labs.disclaimer: Comparing with the reference range is not a diagnosis. Discuss your results with your doctor.
